en: So have you decided what you wish to learn this time?
You bet I have. Especially if it will save me from listening to your snarky remarks again.
Hmph. So? Speak.
How about we review what I've learned?
Sometimes you need to go back to the basics, right? So let's go over the first lesson you gave me.
Hmm, yes. I suppose even you have good ideas sometimes.
Simpleton! Did you expect to be patted on the head like a dog learning a new trick?
Wha...?
Would you please try to use that pea brain of yours?
I will concede that reviewing what I've taught you is a valuable exercise, but you hardly need me to do that! Go review my lessons on your own!
A single second of my time is worth more than your entire life!
Whoa, no need to freak out like that. I'm just saying that reviewing is a big part of training, especially in sports.
This is not a sport, and I am not your coach! This is a martial art, and I'm your lord and master!
Why does everything with you have to be such a hassle? Just help me review what I've learned. Is that so much to ask?
Argh, how you vex me! Fine, I'll use this chance to take out my frustrations upon you!
That doesn't sound very master-like to me.
Prepare yourself, peasant. This may be a lesson review, but only the gods know what I have in store for you!
The gods actually care what you're thinking?
How dare you!? I demand satisfaction! Now prepare yourself!
Oh yeah, let's go!
Okay, Leo, old boy, let's make this a lesson to remember!
You will not vex me this time. Forsooth, there's no point in reacting to inane comments from an addlepated peasant like you.
Well, good to see you're dealing with your anger issues.
Hmph, let us move this elsewhere.
Uh, I dunno. Nothing special. I'll leave it up to you, Leo-kun.
But I just asked you⑬! ...Ahem.
You really have no clue, do you? Fine. Once a witless peasant, always a witless peasant.
Well! Looks like you got that anger of yours under control! Good job, Leo-kun.
Of course I do. I'm not a member of the unwashed masses like you, after all.
Oh, right. You're some kind of aristocrat!
At least you understand that much. Methinks I'll just have to give you another lesson.
Lay it on me!
Very well. Let us find somewhere more private.
Shinada. Could I talk to you for a minute?
Whoa, Leo-kun? You're so serious all of a sudden.
It's about your training. This shall be the last time.
What!? Where's this coming from?
I've changed quite a bit thanks to your advice, and for that, I must admit that I am most grateful.
Umm, you're welcome?
Yes, well... Simply put, as the scion of aristocrats, I must hold fast to my honor.
I must needs grow stronger, that I am able to do so.
I cannot have myself crying out in pain whenever you land a solid blow.
Leo-kun...
So I shall give you no quarter from now on, Shinada. I still expect to be routed, however. That's just how good you are.
But I can accept defeat so long as I can fight with all my strength. I shall channel the pain into the refinement of my being.
Aw, I was having so much fun at your expense, though. Why'd you have to go and ruin it by getting all serious?
But I get it, Leo-kun. I know you have it rough in your own way. But don't worry, because I'm gonna meet you blow for blow.
Shinada... You have my thanks.
Now then, shall we begin? If you are prepared, that is.
Couldn't possibly prepare any more than I have! Let's go!
Very well! Steel yourself, Shinada!
There you are, peasant.
You mind not calling me that? The name's Tatsuo Shinada, just in case you're interested.
Tatsuo Shinada? 'Tis a peasant's name by my noble reckoning.
Well, I have to admit it's pretty average compared to yours.
That you present yourself to me can mean only one thing. You wish to take lessons from me.
Well, yeah, I thought I might check it out. But are your lessons really all that?
Hah! Hearken to me, Shinada. You cannot judge me based on what you ere beheld. The skills I shall teach you are more precious than life itself.
Of course, there is the matter of feudal service. I shan't lift a finger to help those who do not serve me.
Maybe you forgot, but I saved you from those street punks.
And that is why I deigned to take you as my student. And so the debt is paid.
Seriously? For a guy who talks about nobility, that seems awfully stingy.
You serve me once, and I shall repay you in kind. Once. I must keep things fair for my other vassals, after all.
Okay, so what does a guy have to do to get some training around here?
Anything's fine. I'm sure you can think of something despite your addled peasant brain.
Sheesh, you could at least narrow it down a bit. Okay, let me think...
I'm pretty broke, so anything to do with money is out of the question... Oh, I know!
Very well, speak!
Man, could you be any more of an ass? Anyway, I've got some advice I can give you.
You? Advise me? Don't be ridiculous.
I don't take advice from peasants. Besides, my considerable prosperity could hardly be bolstered by your input.
So you say, but you want a girlfriend, don't you?
No, I do not.
Oh, come on. This is just between the two of us. You really want one, right?
Y...Yes. And Mother's been pestering me about getting married, so perhaps...
See!? I knew it! Just relax and trust me, and I'll set you up.
Hrm... Somehow, I feel as though you have tricked me into revealing this.
You told me the truth, Leo-kun. That was the right thing to do!
Do not press your luck, you of lowly birth.
But very well. I shall acquiesce. But you must make yourself useful in your faithful service to me!
There will be no lesson until I'm utterly satisfied.
Oh, you will be! Especially considering the bar is so low.
What was that!? You think to mock me!?
Of course not! Now will you relax, already?
Fine. I'll take you at your word.
Great. So the deal is, you give me a lesson if you like the advice I give you.
Very well. I'm counting on you, Shinada. Do not disappoint me.
Yowch! Learn to pull your punches during our lessons, you brute!
What!? You told me to do whatever I wanted!
Fool! Is your cranium truly empty? What kind of vassal strikes his lord with all his strength!?
Wait, when did I go from student to vassal?
Shinada. You must learn to show respect for those above your station. I don't know why I expect anything better of you, though.
And <Italic>you</Italic> need to stop being such an assface, Leo-kun. But fine. I apologize profusely for the accident of my birth. Happy?
What!? That is no apolog⑬ Oh, never mind! I grow tired of this farce.
At least I know what you are capable of. You're stronger than I thought.
Aww yeah! Thanks!
Now then, Shinada. Did you pick up on anything in particular about my fighting style?
Your fighting style? Uh...
What are you doing? Why are you training if you cannot be bothered to pay attention? What have I told you about wasting my time?
I am taking great care with each blow to ensure my weapons remain in pristine condition.
There are ways to lower the stress upon your weapon no matter what technique you are using.
Really!? That's the first bit of master-like wisdom I've heard from you so far!
Insolent fool! Show some respect.
Relax, will you? It's just, I used to play pro baseball, so I get that it's important to treat equipment properly.
I'll try to keep that in mind.
You learned <Color:9>Thrift Mastery<Color:Default>.
Now then, consider this payment for your service as my vassal. You'll have to do something else for me if you want another lesson.
Never expected to learn anything like that. This feudal service thing is totally worth it!
Ah, the very model of a peasant. I see you do know your place after all. I look forward to what you come up with next.
You fool! That really hurt!
Whoops! Sorry, Leo-kun! But hey, I think I just figured something out during that training.
It doesn't work that way, you witless peasant!
No, I'm serious. I think I'm really onto something!
You learned <Color:9>My Whirlwind Essence (Climax Heat)<Color:Default>.
Did you really come up with that just now? I'll have to slice open that mushy brain of yours someday to see how it works.
Whoa, I'm not letting you vivisect me! But I will commend you on another great lesson, Leo-kun.
Do not make a mockery of my name! 'Tis a moniker that embodies pride, and one my mother and father bestowed upon me! You will refer to me as Master Ayanokoji!
I didn't mean any disrespect. It's just, Ayanokoji's so long... And kind of weird-sounding.
I'll have you know that it is a noble and storied name! It certainly commands more respect than Tatsuo. Who could ever take someone named Tatsuo seriously!?
Fine, fine. Let's just forget this and move on.
Do not think to act the bigger man! You will always be my inferior!
Listen, your lessons are really helping me. I really do want to thank you, Leo-kun.
Really? Well, all right then.
Let us call it even, shall we? If you wish for another lesson, you'll have to do something else for me.
Got it. See you again soon.
Ouch! Knave! Don't you ever learn!?
Whoa, someone needs anger management. Anyway, how's it my fault you failed to keep your guard up?
What!? Fie! Fie and a pox upon you! Just like a peasant! Never taking responsibility!
I could say the same thing about you, y'know.
But whatever. I think I get the hang of it.
You learned <Color:9>My Snapping Turtle<Color:Default>.
You're forgetting this is a lesson and that I am your master. Show me the reverence I deserve!
Oh, I'm very grateful, O Great Exalted Master Ayanokoji.
I detect some sarcasm there. You can show your true gratitude by returning the favor.
That means doing something for me again! Understand!? Or shall I spell it out for your tiny, lower class brain?
Yeah, yeah. Message received loud and clear.
I cannot take this anymore. I feel unwell...
I guess that makes sense, what with that pummeling you took.
And whose fault is that, brute!? Control yourself!
Well, I'm glad we did that review. Got something out of it, too.
You learned <Color:9>Max Thrift Mastery<Color:Default>.
You did? Well. Good... I suppose.
What? You getting all pouty now? Seriously?
Silence! You will never understand the feelings of a noble brutalized at the hands of his vassal.
It must be exhausting having to complain all the time.
Know your place, peasant, or I shall put you in it!
There you go, that's the Leo-kun I know! Can't wait to see where this goes.
Shinadaaa! How many times have I told you not to punch me as if it's a real fight!?
Wait, I thought you were going to control your temper.
Silence, vassal! I have decided that I shall show you the full extent of my wrath!
You sure gave up quick.
Addlepate! Ignoramus! I shall not suffer such disrespect!
All right, all right. Please, forgive me my trespass, <Italic>Master</Italic>.
Hmph! You better have learned something after all the torment you put me through.
Of course I did. I'm not about to waste an opportunity like this, after all.
You learned <Color:9>My Afterimage<Color:Default>.
Very well. I will accept this. A true master can take a bruise or two if his student can learn from it.
But no! 'Tis not one or two! My whole body has become an enormous wale!
Y'know, exaggerating like that isn't very master-like. You're no whale. If anything, all this exercise is helping you lose weight.
That's not what wale⑬ Never you mind! Away from me, I say!
Aw, come on!
'Tis your turn to serve me, vassal! And it best be something exceptional this time. Got it?
Blast! And blast again, I say! Still no match for you.
You may find this frustrating, but I'm learning so much by beating the snot outta you.
You learned <Color:9>My Bashing Combo Essence (Climax Heat)<Color:Default>.
Shinada... Do I detect a hint of gratitude beneath all that sarcasm?
Aw, no need to be so stiff and formal. I mean, you and I are pals, aren't we, Leo-kun!?
Enough about that. Whatever happened with that girl you met?
Oh. Maybe I shouldn't have asked.
She's my girlfriend now.
Oh, sorry it didn't⑬ Wait. Did you just say what I think you did?
Are you serious!? Like seriously serious?
Of course I am! 'Tis no tall tale I tell!
That's awesome, Leo-kun! I'm so happy for you!
So who asked who out? Did you ask her!?
Of course I did! That's the gentleman's duty, after all!
Wow! I can't remember the last time I was so happy for someone! You're, like... the Shogun of Suave!
